newsitem.title: USA: Orbital says gets NASA vehicle contract.
newsitem.headline: Orbital says gets NASA vehicle contract.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Corp said Tuesday it has been selected by NASA's Dryden Research Center to design and produce four Pegasus-derivative launch vehicles for the space agency's Hyper-X program.
In a statement, the company did not disclose the value of the contract.

In its statement, the company said Hyper-X is a small unmanned research aircraft that will ride atop a Pegasus first stage booster air-launched from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration's B-52 aircraft off the coast of California.

After achieving a predetermined speed, the Hyper-X vehicle will separate from the rocket and fly under its own power, reaching speeds of up to 10 times the speed of sound and altitudes of up to 100,000 feet, the company said.
